title: Project specification and data-source register
summary: The governing documents of the worktree: the investigation specification, the analysis-stack design and build status, the data-source register, the reanalysis-suite scope, and a working-draft test-architecture plan.
description_md: These documents define how Cygnus works. They are published as maintained in the worktree, with locations of private storage replaced by placeholders. They describe intended practice and design; where a document lists a module or service, check its stated status before treating it as available.
citation: Project Cygnus / Astraea, project specification documents (2026).
